description: This file defines a simplistic linked list implementation in C, including functions for creating, cloning, destroying, and manipulating linked lists and their iterators. It provides basic list operations such as append, prepend, find, remove, delete, iterate, and access by index, with support for shallow and deep cloning. The file also includes iterator support for traversing the list.
